row: This is a Health and Wellness channel where we strive to give you the resources to take control of your health. Dr. Dalton Brunner is a Chiropractor in Shawnee, Kansas who strives for excellence every time someone walks through his doors. On this channel we give you tools and resources so you can be have more education to make the best choices for your health! Feel free to comment questions or reach out to Dr. Brunner personally if you would like to have a consultation.
